findings.evidence: grep: `weightedDegree` is `(Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ w).toAddMonoidHom` at `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/WeilDivisor.lean:266`; Mathlib has `Finsupp.range_linearCombination : LinearMap.range (linearCombination R v) = span R (range v)` at `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Finsupp/LinearCombination.lean:123` and `Submodule.span_int_eq_addSubgroupClosure` at `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Span/Defs.lean:233`.
findings.fix: Prove it by unfolding/simping `weightedDegree` in this file and rewriting with `Finsupp.range_linearCombination`, then convert `Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range w)` to `AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)` using `Submodule.span_int_eq_addSubgroupClosure`.
findings.issue: `weightedDegree_range` manually proves the range of the Finsupp linear-combination map by `le_antisymm`, duplicating Mathlib's range/span theorem for linear combinations.

summary: One range proof rederives existing Mathlib Finsupp/module range API instead of using it. The author reply does not remove the issue because this PR edits the same file where `weightedDegree` is defined, so the body is available at the new lemma site.
